aiOverview.content: Brooks Rosser, a 22-year-old singer from Bel Air, Maryland, and a dementia care medication technician, is a standout contestant on American Idol Season 24 (2026). Known for his unique, emotional voice and signature falsetto, he earned a Platinum Ticket, advanced to the Top 20, and impressed judges with performances of songs like Noah Kahan's "Everywhere, Everything". Watch Brooks Rosser's emotional performance of 'Everywhere, Everything' on American Idol:57sAmerican IdolYouTube• Mar 9, 2026 57s Key details regarding Brooks Rosser on American Idol 2026: Background: Prior to the show, he had limited public performing experience, focusing mainly on playing guitar, making his vocal success an "unexpected talent" story. Audition & Platinum Ticket: He stunned judges Lionel Richie, Carrie Underwood, and Luke Bryan with his unique vocal tone during his initial audition. Journey: He was named as part of the Top 20 following an emotional performance in early March 2026, solidifying his spot in the competition. Performances: He has performed notable covers, including Sam Barber's "Drowning" during Hollywood Week and "Everywhere, Everything" by Noah Kahan. Note: There was also a different contestant named Brooks Kidd who auditioned in an earlier season (Season 20, 2021).
